description_en: Places an outbound call when an agent is online
description_zh: 当座席在线时，通过此接口进行呼叫
name: CloudPreviewoutcall

parameters.help_en: The ID of the call center
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The agent ID. The ID must be a 3- to 10-digit number
parameters.name: cno

parameters.help_en: The customer's phone number. For landlines, include the area code. For mobile numbers, do not include a leading 0. If number masking is enabled, use the `customerNumberKey` value from the screen pop to place the call. For an [encrypted outbound call](../%E5%AD%97%E6%AE%B5%E5%AE%9A%E4%B9%89/%E6%8E%A5%E5%8F%A3%E9%83%A8%E5%88%86/%E5%8A%A0%E5%AF%86%E5%A4%96%E5%91%BC%E5%8F%B7%E7%A0%81%E5%8A%A0%E5%AF%86%E8%A7%84%E5%88%99.md), the number, if encrypted, must be URL-encoded. If your account is configured to support outbound calls with an extension, you can use the `PhoneNumber-Extension` format
parameters.help_zh: 需要进行呼叫的客户方电话号码，固话带区号，手机不加0。 当开启号码隐藏设置时，可从弹屏事件中获取customerNumberKey的值，进行外呼；[加密外呼](../字段定义/接口部分/加密外呼号码加密规则.md)；如果是加密的号码，需要URLEncode后传入；当外呼相关配置-支持分机号外呼开启后，此字段可支持传手机号-分机号格式
parameters.name: tel

parameters.help_en: The timeout period for calling the agent, in seconds. The value must be between 5 and 60, inclusive. The default value is 30
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫座席侧超时时间；取值范围 5<=timeout<=60，默认30(单位:s)
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en: The timeout period for calling the customer, in seconds. The value must be between 5 and 60, inclusive. The default value is 45
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫客户侧超时时间；取值范围 5<=dialTelTimeout<=60，默认45(单位:s)
parameters.name: dial_tel_timeout

parameters.help_en:
A JSON string that specifies channel variables. You can use channel variables to:
1. Populate fields in event notifications.
2. Store as custom fields in call records.
3. Pass to downstream services through SIP headers.
Format: `[{"name":"variable_name","value":"variable_value","type":"variable_type"}]`
parameters.help_zh: 通道变量可以在以下场景中使用：1. 事件推送，作为推送字段使用2. 通话记录中，将字段存储在自定义字段3. 通过SIP-Header方式将字段传到呼叫的下游链路格式如: [{"name":"mainUniqueId","value":"cdr_main_unique_id","type":"2"},{"name":"callType","value":"cdr_call_type","type":"2"}]name：变量名称value：变量值type：变量类型，1.普通变量 2.PJSIP_HEADER变量（用于将变量通过SIP-Header方式传到客户侧，最多支持5个）
parameters.name: call_variables

parameters.help_en: A unique request ID. If you do not specify this parameter, the system generates one. If the value is encrypted, it must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 请求唯一id；取值：如果没有传入值则系统会生产。如果是加密的号码，需要URLEncode后传入
parameters.name: request_unique_id

parameters.help_en: A comma-separated list of up to five backup phone numbers. If the call to the primary number (specified in the `Tel` parameter) fails, the system calls these numbers
parameters.help_zh: 备用外呼号码；tel没呼通时呼叫备用号码，最多支持5个号码，多个之间用逗号分隔
parameters.name: backup_tels

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to conduct a satisfaction survey. If you omit this parameter, the system uses the enterprise-level setting
parameters.help_zh: 是否满意度调查；0.不进行满意度调查 1.进行满意度调查，默认：取企业配置
parameters.name: is_investigation

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform ASR transcription for the call recording. The default value is `1`
parameters.help_zh: 此次通话录音是否进行ASR转写；0.不进行 1.进行 默认：1
parameters.name: cdr_is_asr

parameters.help_en: The caller ID to display to the called party. You can specify an enterprise trunk number or a pre-configured customer-side caller ID
parameters.help_zh: 可传入企业中继号码或设置好的客户侧外显号码
parameters.name: ob_clid

parameters.help_en: The area code for the caller ID. The system selects a number within this area code to display as the caller ID. If both `ObClid` and `ObClidAreaCode` are specified, `ObClid` takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: 指定外显区号；传入区号，在指定区号下外显号码；如果obClid和obClidAreaCode都传的情况下，按照obClid外显
parameters.name: ob_clid_area_code

parameters.help_en: The customer-side caller ID group. To use this parameter, your account must support routing by identifier. If this parameter is specified, the `ObClid` parameter is ignored
parameters.help_zh: 客户侧外显号码组；使用clidGroup需要账号支持按标识路由，使用此参数时clid参数无效
parameters.name: ob_clid_group

parameters.help_en:
A list of caller IDs in a JSON string. Example: `[{"clid":"1708587xxxx","priority":1},{"clid":"1304412xxxx","priority":2},{"clid":"0107990xxxx","priority":3}]`

You can specify a maximum of 10 caller IDs for a single call. If you specify for one number, you must specify it for all numbers in the list
parameters.help_zh: 外显号码集合, 格式如: [{"clid":"1708587xxxx","priority":1},{"clid":"1304412xxxx","priority":2},{"clid":"0107990xxxx","priority":3}] clid：外显号码（String类型）（必填）priority：优先级（Integer类型）（非必填） 特别说明： 一次呼叫最多允许传10个指定号码；若指定了号码优先级，要求所有传入的号码都必传
parameters.name: clid_list

Code.description_en:
The status code.

`OK` indicates the request was successful.

For a list of other error codes, see [API error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。
返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[API错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）
